root_cause.journal-ack-before-durable-side-effects: The dispatcher acked every rumor in a finally block after a per-handler catch (at-most-once), and persistPendingRemoval swallowed a failed IndexedDB write so the leave handler resolved. A durable side effect that failed was therefore indistinguishable from success and its only replay source (the journal entry) was deleted.
root_cause.journal-ack-failure-replays-applied-rows: A failed ack was only warned. The row then replayed at every later subscription in the session (re-subscribe re-lists the journal) and once per startup while the delete kept failing. Narrower than filed: a working delete at the next startup already removed it, so '30 days' only applies to a persistently failing delete.
root_cause.journal-replayed-leave-evicts-rejoined-m: enqueueLeave captured the member's leaf identity from the CURRENT tree at handler time. On a journal replay after a re-join that is the re-joined leaf, which then matches at fire time and is removed.
root_cause.pending-removal-compare-delete-single-tx: deleteRowsStillMatching re-read with entries() (readonly transaction) and deleted with delMany (a second readwrite transaction). The per-tab chain does not cover another tab, whose put to the same key could land between the two and be deleted.

fix.dispatcher: Ack-on-success. The seen-LRU now stores per rumor whether its handlers completed (Map<id, boolean>, same eviction). The entry is acked only when every matching handler completed without throwing; a throw or a fan-out cut short by disposal leaves it journaled, and the next subscription replays it. Dedup is unchanged: a rumor is attempted once per dispatcher; a duplicate of a completed rumor acks, a duplicate of a failed one neither re-runs nor acks. RumorHandler documents the contract: throw iff a needed local side effect did not durably land; failures another mechanism retries are caught in the handler.
fix.handlers: persistPendingRemoval/recordPendingRemoval reject on a failed write (warned; the in-memory removal stays queued and still commits) and the leave handler propagates it. profileRequestHandler catches a failed self-profile reply send (the requester re-asks, AC-SEND-10) so a replay never answers a stale request. pollHandler's vote path now throws when the held-close recovery leaves the poll state unknown (the vote was silently dropped and acked before). Comments in chat/poll/profile handlers that relied on 'acked even when it throws' were corrected.
fix.ack_retry: rumorJournal.ackRumor records a failed delete in a session-level set and rethrows. A later successful ack and every listPendingRumors retry the recorded deletes best-effort, and listPendingRumors never returns a recorded (already applied) entry; it filters before retrying. Across a reload the set is gone: the row replays once more (idempotent) and is acked then.
fix.replayed_leave: marmot-ts exposes the message's epoch (privateMessage.epoch) and the post-decrypt ClientState, but neither marmot-ts nor ts-mls records a per-leaf join epoch, so the epoch alone cannot date a membership. EpochResolver therefore journals, with each application message, the sender pubkey's leaf identity in the ratchet tree of the epoch the message was encrypted in (current tree, or historicalReceiverData's tree for a past-epoch message). enqueueLeave(groupId, pubkey, rumorId) uses that journaled identity (resolveLeaveLeafIdentity) and falls back to the current leaf only when the journal has none (legacy row, failed put) or is unreadable. A replay after a re-join carries the departed identity, mismatches at fire time and is settled, never proposed.
fix.single_txn_delete: deleteRowsStillMatching runs one readwrite transaction through the idb-keyval store callback: a cursor over the group's key range compares each row in-transaction (stillMatches) and cursor.delete()s only rows that still match. IndexedDB serialises readwrite transactions on a store across connections, so another tab's put lands before the compare (kept) or after the commit (re-created). Used by both the settle path and resume. An aborted transaction deletes nothing and rejects.

handler_replay_audit.chat (kind 9): Replay-safe: appendMessage is insert-if-absent by rumor id; version bump and unread only on insert; resolvePendingSignalsForSlot idempotent; announcement gates re-evaluated (documented F5 cross-session behaviour). poll_close summary: hold (one per poll+sender) plus journal retention converge on one row. An appendMessage failure now stays journaled (it was lost before).
handler_replay_audit.reaction (kind 7): Replay-safe but NOT retried: applyInboundRumor failures are caught and the rumor is acked (unchanged). Reported as a follow-up.
handler_replay_audit.delete/edit (kind 5): Replay-safe but NOT retried: applyDeleteEditSignal failures are caught and acked (unchanged). Reported as a follow-up.
handler_replay_audit.profile: Replay-safe: mergeMemberProfile last-writer-wins; the accepted announcement uses the atomic consumePendingDirectInviteMarker, so a replay never re-posts; the one-shot gate is per dispatcher, so the next subscription retries a failed merge. recordRequestAnswered is best-effort (round 1).
handler_replay_audit.profile request: Never throws (round 1): recording and answering are best-effort; the requester's retry machinery re-asks (AC-SEND-10).
handler_replay_audit.poll open/vote/close: Replay-safe: first-open-wins with recovery on a duplicate open; votes via compare-and-set saveVoteIfNewer; close held once per (poll, sender), earliest receipt kept, applied only to an open poll. Hold-and-rethrow paths now ALSO stay journaled: the in-session retry (next poll message) and the next-subscription replay converge on one close (tested: replayed vote after an unknown-state failure finds the held close applied and drops the late vote). Round 1: a vote whose save fails is queued as an early vote before the rethrow, so a close before the replay counts it.
handler_replay_audit.leave_intent: Replay-safe: queue dedup per (pubkey, identity), identity now from first receipt, stale-leaf guard, identity-scoped settle. Round 1: a duplicate re-puts the queued entry; a failed journal identity read throws (no current-leaf fallback).

open_questions: Reaction (kind 7) and delete/edit (kind 5) handlers still swallow storage failures and ack; making them throw would extend the retry to them. Not changed here (behaviour change outside the four findings).

Residual for the replayed-leave fix: a re-join from the same reusable last-resort key package with no intervening commit by that member reproduces identical leaf keys (documented in code and groups.md). A true fix needs a per-leaf join epoch from upstream.

retrospective.harder_than_needed: The finding's suggested approach (store the epoch, compare with the member's leaf join epoch) assumed data ts-mls/marmot-ts do not record; I had to read the installed ingest and processPrivateMessage code to find usable evidence (the sender's leaf in the message-epoch tree). Switching the pending-removal suite to the store-callback transaction also forced migrating it and autoCommitLeave's harness from Map mocks to fake-indexeddb.
retrospective.surprised_by: The ack-failure finding was overstated: a working delete at the next startup already cleared the row; the real cost was in-session re-dispatch on re-subscribe. Also the poll vote path silently dropped and acked a vote on unknown state despite a comment claiming a journal replay would re-deliver it.

remediation_round_1.trigger: Reviewer REJECTED (sev-6 duplicate-leave ack without a write) + Codex HIGH (journal lookup failure fell back to the current leaf) + 2 Codex mediums + reviewer sev-4/3/3/2 + Codex low.
fix: 1 (Codex HIGH): getJournaledSenderLeafIdentity returns {journaled, identity?}; resolveLeaveLeafIdentity rejects on a failed read (handler throws, entry kept, replay retries). Current leaf only with no journal row (live first receipt whose journal write failed) or a legacy identity-less row.
2 (sev-6/Codex medium): recordPendingRemoval re-puts the QUEUED entry (unchanged receivedAt) on a duplicate; identity-less duplicates stay memory-only.
3 (Codex medium): handleVote queues a vote whose save failed as an early vote (receipt-stamped) before rethrowing; a failed queue rethrows.

4 (sev-4): poison guard — recordRumorFailure (read-increment-put, one txn) counted once per failed attempt; at RUMOR_JOURNAL_MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS (5) the dispatcher acks with a warning carrying groupId, kind, rumorId, attempts. A failed count write is warned and keeps the entry; disposal cut-short is not counted.
5 (sev-3): profileRequestHandler catches recordRequestEmitted and handleIncomingProfileRequest failures too (never throws).
6 (sev-3): profileHandler recordRequestAnswered caught + warned as best-effort (it only suppresses a redundant re-request; a replay could not complete it since the merge reports no change).
7 (sev-2): putRumor uses idb-keyval update() (get+put in one readwrite txn), keeping an existing senderLeafIdentity and the attempt count when the new value has none.
8 (Codex low): appliedUnacked pruned on age eviction (list + sweep), group/account clears, capped at 1000 (oldest forgotten); header comment rewrapped.
